endorsements.name: Moritz Jodeit
endorsements.label: Hacking Video Conferencing Systems
endorsements.description: High-end videoconferencing systems are widely deployed at critical locations such as corporate meeting rooms or boardrooms. Many of these systems are reachable from the Internet or via the telephone network while in many cases the security considerations are limited to the secure deployment and configuration.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Europe 2013

evidence-links.title: Black Hat EU 2013 - Hacking Video Conferencing Systems

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
